chapter: Outside the Canvas, Inside the Lens: Greenery Chapter
act_title: Outside the Canvas, Inside the Lens: Greenery Chapter

quests.title: Outside the Canvas, Inside the Lens: Greenery Chapter

dialogue.t: Why does Miss Moriko always give me these weird commissions?

dialogue.sit: You ran out of inspiration again?

dialogue.t: Ah, Traveler, what brings you here? It's been a while, and I thought you'd traveled to other nations.
*sigh* How I wish I was in a better condition. Then I could travel as freely as you do.
And Miss Moriko wouldn't be able to come and nag me on work progress every day...
My illustrations last time were well received. Many novelists have since been requesting my works.
Although Miss Moriko has rejected many jobs for me, the remaining commissions are still overwhelming...
At first, I thought outside of Inazuma, Liyue and Mondstadt would be the furthest stages for their stories to unfold...
Yet they now have protagonists adventuring in Sumeru, and Fontaine even.
Well, enough of my complaints. Traveler, is your Kamera still functional?

dialogue.sit: Do you want me to take more pictures?

dialogue.t: Well, my payment last time was quite decent, wasn't it?
So, Traveler, please take more pictures throughout the world for me!

dialogue.sit: You know you can just put up a request at the Adventurers' Guild, right?

dialogue.t: I'll be counting on you then! Hehe, I've got my notebook ready!
If you hadn't shown up, I'd ask Miss Moriko to look for you...

quests.description: An illustrator named Asagiri from Inazuma seems to be troubled by something…
